title: Ejecuta acción lectura Semaphore
text:
hore evidence established:

```text
PIPELINE_STATE=done
PIPELINE_RESULT=stopped
RESULT_REASON=test
STOP_REASON=UNKNOWN
STOP_ACTOR=UNKNOWN
TERMINATED_BY=UNKNOWN
```

Retrospective Semaphore block/job endpoints returned HTTP 404. No further Semaphore query is currently required. The historical jq action is terminal and MUST NOT be retried.

## Exact-SHA first-block reproduction

The first production fallback block:

```text
GRU validation / Core CI contracts
```

was reproduced in a fresh isolated clone at the exact candidate SHA.

Result:

```text
CORE_CI_FIRST_BLOCK=PASS
```

Observed details:

- all requested unittest groups passed;
- one pandas-dependent runtime-boundary test was skipped because pandas was unavailable;
- Python compilation passed;
- shell syntax validation passed;
- static contract checks passed;
- detached checkout failed only on the branch-context assertion;
- recreating the real Semaphore branch context with a local `feature/GRU` branch pointing at the same exact SHA made the block pass;
- no later block was executed;
- no source repository, Semaphore, VPS, production, commit or push mutation occurred.

## Corrected interpretation

1. There is no reproduced failure in the first `GRU validation / Core CI contracts` block.
2. The detached-HEAD assertion failure was a reproduction-harness mismatch, not a candidate defect.
3. The pandas skip is an environment-dependent skip and did not make the block fail.
4. `RESULT_REASON=test` cannot now be used to infer that the first validation block failed.
5. The actual stopped pipeline may have progressed to a later block.
6. The next useful evidence source is the durable state written by later stages on the VPS.
7. No code change, commit, push, Semaphore rerun, or additional Semaphore query is justified yet.

## Exact next boundary

Perform one read-only VPS provenance inspection for the exact SHA. Inspect only:

- full-corpus durable request/active/result state;
- exact-SHA production deployment markers;
- current production checkout identity;
- P2 durable request/active/result state.

Do not execute any repository CI/deploy/observer/worker script. Do not modify state. Do not start/stop services.

## Current state

```text
CANDIDATE_SHA=0c11a13e0c6ceb4c9eab3258ce4a10728fcb6390
CORE_CI_FIRST_BLOCK=PASS
FIRST_BLOCK_FAILURE_REPRODUCED=NO
PIPELINE_RESULT=stopped
RESULT_REASON=test
CONCRETE_FAILED_JOB=UNKNOWN
CONCRETE_FAILED_TEST=UNKNOWN
FURTHEST_PIPELINE_STAGE=UNKNOWN
NEXT_ACTION=READONLY_VPS_DURABLE_STAGE_PROVENANCE
SAFE_TO_RERUN_SEMAPHORE=NO
SAFE_TO_CREATE_NEW_COMMIT=NO_EVIDENCE
FINAL_GO=NO
DIAGNOSIS_STATUS=PARTIALLY_RESOLVED
```

STDOUT/STDERR

SHA256=549b0e62daa4b0b38a256e2040f22e3877fd30a1e7ab7da5b78760450889f5e9

ChatGPT said:

Queda reconciliado: el SHA exacto pasa completamente el primer bloque GRU validation / Core CI contracts. El fallo en detached HEAD fue del harness de reproducción; al restaurar el contexto real feature/GRU sobre el mismo SHA, el bloque pasó. El SKIPPED por pandas tampoco constituye fallo del bloque.

Por tanto, el estado pasa a FIRST_BLOCK_FAILURE_REPRODUCED=NO. No corresponde modificar código, crear otro commit, consultar Semaphore de nuevo ni relanzarlo. Actualicé el diagnóstico: 
DIAGNOSIS_AI_LOOP_LAST_FAILURE_RECONCILED_V3_20260925.md
, SHA-256 549b0e62daa4b0b38a256e2040f22e3877fd30a1e7ab7da5b78760450889f5e9.

La acción exacta siguiente es localizar el último rastro durable alcanzado por el pipeline original en el VPS:

Bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077

SHA="0c11a13e0c6ceb4c9eab3258ce4a10728fcb6390"
VPS="/opt/ai-loop/bin/vps-ssh"
E="$(mktemp -d "/tmp/ai-loop-vps-stage-provenance-${SHA:0:12}.XXXXXX")"

fail() {
  echo "READONLY_VPS_PROVENANCE=FAILED"
  echo "BLOCKER=$1"
  echo "EVIDENCE_DIR=$E"
  exit "${2:-90}"
}

test -x "$VPS" || fail "VPS_WRAPPER_MISSING:$VPS" 91
command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "MISSING_COMMAND:sha256sum" 92

REMOTE_SCRIPT="$(cat <<'REMOTE'
set -u

SHA="0c11a13e0c6ceb4c9eab3258ce4a10728fcb6390"
SHORT="${SHA:0:12}"

PROD="/opt/bot_trad/bot_trading_gru"
P2="/var/lib/bot-trading-gru-p2"

remote_user="$(id -un 2>/dev/null || printf unknown)"
remote_uid="$(id -u 2>/dev/null || printf unknown)"
remote_home="$(getent passwd "$remote_uid" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: 'NR==1 {print $6}')"

printf 'REMOTE_USER=%s\n' "$remote_user"
printf 'REMOTE_UID=%s\n' "$remote_uid"
printf 'REMOTE_HOME=%s\n' "${remote_home:-UNKNOWN}"
printf 'TARGET_SHA=%s\n' "$SHA"

FC_TRACE=0
FC_SUCCESS=0
FC_FAILED=0
DEPLOY_TRACE=0
P2_TRACE=0

echo "===== PRODUCTION CHECKOUT IDENTITY ====="
if [ -d "$PROD/.git" ]; then
  prod_branch="$(git -c safe.directory="$PROD" -C "$PROD" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || true)"
  prod_head="$(git -c safe.directory="$PROD" -C "$PROD" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
  printf 'PRODUCTION_BRANCH=%s\n' "${prod_branch:-UNKNOWN}"
  printf 'PRODUCTION_HEAD=%s\n' "${prod_head:-UNKNOWN}"

  if [ "$prod_head" = "$SHA" ]; then
    echo "PRODUCTION_HEAD_MATCH=YES"
  else
    echo "PRODUCTION_HEAD_MATCH=NO"
  fi
else
  echo "PRODUCTION_REPO=ABSENT_OR_UNREADABLE"
fi

echo
echo "===== FULL CORPUS DURABLE STATE ====="

if [ -n "${remote_home:-}" ]; then
  FC="$remote_home/.local/state/bot-trading-gru-full-corpus"
else
  FC=""
fi

show_fc_identity_file() {
  f="$1"
  label="$2"

  if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
    echo "${label}=ABSENT"
    return
  fi

  if [ ! -r "$f" ]; then
    echo "${label}=UNREADABLE"
    return
  fi

  stat -c "${label}_STAT mtime=%y size=%s mode=%a uid=%u gid=%g" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true

  file_sha="$(sed -n 's/^EXPECTED_SHA=//p' "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
  if [ "$file_sha" != "$SHA" ]; then
    echo "${label}_TARGET_SHA_MATCH=NO"
    return
  fi

  FC_TRACE=1
  echo "${label}_TARGET_SHA_MATCH=YES"

  sed -n -E \
    '/^(MODE|EXPECTED_SHA|REPOSITORY|RUN_ID|CONTRACT_VERSION|WORKTREE|PID)=/p' \
    "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
}

if [ -n "$FC" ]; then
  printf 'FULL_CORPUS_STATE_DIR=%s\n' "$FC"

  show_fc_identity_file "$FC/request.env" "FULL_CORPUS_REQUEST"
  show_fc_identity_file "$FC/active.env" "FULL_CORPUS_ACTIVE"

  if [ -d "$FC/results" ] && [ -r "$FC/results" ] && [ -x "$FC/results" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r d; do
      [ -n "$d" ] || continue

      FC_TRACE=1
      echo "FULL_CORPUS_RESULT_DIR=$d"
      stat -c \
        'FULL_CORPUS_RESULT_DIR_STAT mtime=%y mode=%a uid=%u gid=%g' \
        "$d" 2>/dev/null || true

      status="$d/worker.status"
      if [ -r "$status" ]; then
        echo "--- FULL_CORPUS worker.status ---"
        sed -n -E \
          '/^(state|exit_code|mode|sha|run_id|contract|reason|timestamp)=/p' \
          "$status" || true

        state="$(sed -n 's/^state=//p' "$status" | head -n1)"
        case "$state" in
          SUCCESS) FC_SUCCESS=1 ;;
          FAILED)  FC_FAILED=1 ;;
        esac
      else
        echo "FULL_CORPUS_WORKER_STATUS=ABSENT_OR_UNREADABLE"
      fi

      if [ -r "$d/worker.log" ]; then
        echo "--- FULL_CORPUS exact-stage markers ---"
        grep -E \
          'FULL_CORPUS_|CANDIDATE_|DEPENDENCY_|HISTORY_|VALIDATION_|(^|[[:space:]])ERROR:' \
          "$d/worker.log" 2>/dev/null \
          | tail -n 120 || true
      fi
    done < <(
      find "$FC/results" \
        -mindepth 1 \
        -maxdepth 1 \
        -type d \
        -name "semaphore-*-${SHORT}" \
        -print 2>/dev/null | sort
    )
  else
    echo "FULL_CORPUS_RESULTS=ABSENT_OR_UNREADABLE"
  fi

  if [ -r "$FC/supervisor.log" ]; then
    echo "--- FULL_CORPUS supervisor exact-SHA markers ---"
    grep -F "$SHORT" "$FC/supervisor.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 80 || true
  fi
else
  echo "FULL_CORPUS_STATE_DIR=UNKNOWN"
fi

echo
echo "===== DEPLOYMENT DURABLE MARKERS ====="

show_deploy_marker() {
  f="$1"
  label="$2"

  if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
    echo "${label}=ABSENT"
    return
  fi

  if [ ! -r "$f" ]; then
    echo "${label}=UNREADABLE"
    return
  fi

  stat -c "${label}_STAT mtime=%y size=%s mode=%a uid=%u gid=%g" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true

  if grep -Fq "$SHA" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
    DEPLOY_TRACE=1
    echo "${label}_TARGET_SHA_MATCH=YES"
    sed -n '1,5p' "$f"
  else
    echo "${label}_TARGET_SHA_MATCH=NO"
  fi
}

show_deploy_marker \
  "/tmp/bot_trad_feature_gru_sync_verified.sha" \
  "DEPLOY_SYNC_MARKER"

show_deploy_marker \
  "/tmp/bot_trad_feature_gru_release_status.txt" \
  "DEPLOY_RELEASE_STATUS"

show_deploy_marker \
  "/tmp/bot_trad_feature_gru_deploy_engine.txt" \
  "DEPLOY_ENGINE_MARKER"

echo
echo "===== P2 DURABLE STATE ====="

show_p2_identity_file() {
  f="$1"
  label="$2"

  if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
    echo "${label}=ABSENT"
    return
  fi

  if [ ! -r "$f" ]; then
    echo "${label}=UNREADABLE"
    return
  fi

  stat -c "${label}_STAT mtime=%y size=%s mode=%a uid=%u gid=%g" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true

  file_sha="$(sed -n 's/^EXPECTED_SHA=//p' "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
  if [ "$file_sha" != "$SHA" ]; then
    echo "${label}_TARGET_SHA_MATCH=NO"
    return
  fi

  P2_TRACE=1
  echo "${label}_TARGET_SHA_MATCH=YES"

  sed -n -E \
    '/^(EXPECTED_SHA|REPOSITORY|CIRCLE_BUILD_NUM|RUN_ID|PID|MODE|WORKTREE)=/p' \
    "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
}

if [ -d "$P2" ]; then
  show_p2_identity_file "$P2/request.env" "P2_REQUEST"
  show_p2_identity_file "$P2/active.env" "P2_ACTIVE"

  if [ -d "$P2/results" ] && [ -r "$P2/results" ] && [ -x "$P2/results" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r f; do
      [ -n "$f" ] || continue

      P2_TRACE=1
      echo "P2_RESULT_FILE=$f"
      stat -c \
        'P2_RESULT_STAT mtime=%y size=%s mode=%a uid=%u gid=%g' \
        "$f" 2>/dev/null || true

      echo "--- P2 status ---"
      tr ' ' '\n' < "$f" 2>/dev/null \
        | grep -E \
          '^(state|exit_code|sha|build|reason|timestamp)=' \
        || true
    done < <(
      find "$P2/results" \
        -maxdepth 1 \
        -type f \
        -name "p2-*-${SHA}.status" \
        -print 2>/dev/null | sort
    )
  else
    echo "P2_RESULTS=ABSENT_OR_UNREADABLE"
  fi
else
  echo "P2_STATE_DIR=ABSENT_OR_UNREADABLE"
fi

echo
echo "===== READ-ONLY STAGE CLASSIFICATION ====="

printf 'FULL_CORPUS_TRACE=%s\n' "$FC_TRACE"
printf 'FULL_CORPUS_TERMINAL_SUCCESS=%s\n' "$FC_SUCCESS"
printf 'FULL_CORPUS_TERMINAL_FAILED=%s\n' "$FC_FAILED"
printf 'DEPLOY_TRACE=%s\n' "$DEPLOY_TRACE"
printf 'P2_TRACE=%s\n' "$P2_TRACE"

if [ "$P2_TRACE" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "FURTHEST_DURABLE_STAGE=P2"
elif [ "$DEPLOY_TRACE" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "FURTHEST_DURABLE_STAGE=DEPLOY"
elif [ "$FC_SUCCESS" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "FURTHEST_DURABLE_STAGE=FULL_CORPUS_TERMINAL_SUCCESS"
elif [ "$FC_TRACE" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "FURTHEST_DURABLE_STAGE=FULL_CORPUS_LAUNCH_OR_EXECUTION"
else
  echo "FURTHEST_DURABLE_STAGE=NO_LATER_DURABLE_TRACE_FOUND"
fi

echo "REMOTE_MUTATION=NO"
echo "REPOSITORY_MUTATION=NO"
echo "SERVICE_ACTION=NO"
echo "WORKER_EXECUTION=NO"
echo "DEPLOY_EXECUTION=NO"
echo "SEMAPHORE_QUERY=NO"
echo "SEMAPHORE_RERUN=NO"
echo "READONLY_VPS_PROVENANCE=PASS"
REMOTE
)"

set +e
"$VPS" "$REMOTE_SCRIPT" >"$E/vps-stage-provenance.txt" 2>&1
rc=$?
set -e

cat "$E/vps-stage-provenance.txt"

if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "READONLY_VPS_PROVENANCE=FAILED"
  echo "VPS_WRAPPER_EXIT_CODE=$rc"
  echo "EVIDENCE_DIR=$E"
  exit "$rc"
fi

echo "===== LOCAL EVIDENCE DIGEST ====="
sha256sum "$E/vps-stage-provenance.txt"

echo "LOCAL_ONLY_EVIDENCE_WRITE=YES"
echo "VPS_MUTATION=NO"
echo "SEMAPHORE_MUTATION=NO"
echo "SOURCE_REPOSITORY_MUTATION=NO"
echo "EVIDENCE_DIR=$E"

Esta acción no intenta reproducir más etapas; únicamente determina qué etapas sí dejaron rastros para el SHA exacto. Devuélveme la salida literal. El valor decisivo será FURTHEST_DURABLE_STAGE, junto con worker.status, markers de deploy o estado P2 que aparezcan.
